args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
Emma Johnson's Trip: June 10-20, 2024

ESSENTIALS:
- Valid ID/Passport
- Travel insurance documents
- Hotel reservation confirmations
- Flight tickets/boarding passes
- Credit cards and cash
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Travel adapter (if needed)

CLOTHING:
- Swimwear (at least 2-3 sets)
- Light, breathable clothing
- Casual outfits for dinners
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Flip-flops or sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling at Hanauma Bay)
- Hat with brim for sun protection
- Sunglasses

BEACH & WATER ACTIVITIES:
- Beach towel
- Reef-safe sunscreen (SPF 50+)
- After-sun lotion or aloe vera
- Waterproof phone case
- Snorkel gear (mask, snorkel, fins)
- Beach bag
- Reusable water bottle

HIKING & OUTDOOR ACTIVITIES:
- Hiking boots or sturdy sneakers
- Lightweight hiking pants/shorts
- Moisture-wicking t-shirts
- Small backpack for day trips
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Trail snacks

EVENING ACTIVITIES:
- Luau-appropriate attire (June 16)
- Semi-casual outfit for nice dinners
- Jewelry/accessories

TOILETRIES:
- Toothbrush and toothpaste
- Shampoo and conditioner
- Body wash
- Deodorant
- Hairbrush/comb
- Makeup (if desired)
- Prescription medications
- Contact lenses and solution (if needed)

MISCELLANEOUS:
- Books or e-reader
- Travel pillow
- Earplugs
- Eye mask
- Small umbrella or rain jacket
- Ziplock bags for wet items
- Laundry bag

ACTIVITY-SPECIFIC ITEMS:
- June 11 (Waikiki Beach): Beach games, beach blanket
- June 12 (Hanauma Bay): Underwater camera, dry bag
- June 13 (Diamond Head): Hiking poles (optional), extra water
- June 14 (Pearl Harbor): Respectful attire
- June 15 (North Shore): Car essentials, cooler for drinks
- June 16 (Luau): Hawaiian shirt/dress if desired
- June 18 (Kailua Beach kayaking): Quick-dry clothing, waterproof watch
- June 19 (Shopping): Reusable shopping bags
